periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Matching dollars ran only at the indoor winter market two Saturdays a month, and 140 households used them. Secured garden sites in Riverside and East Flats for this year. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harbor Area Food Bank.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open the outdoor market with weekly matching dollars and prepare the two new garden plots.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Opened the outdoor market in May with matching dollars every week, which brought use to 410 households and put the strategy back on pace. Prepared beds at the Riverside and East Flats garden plots. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harbor Area Food Bank, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open the two new garden plots, add a Saturday farm stand at the Bayfront library, and route harvest donations to pantries.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Peak season brought two new community garden plots in Riverside and East Flats, a Saturday farm stand at the Bayfront library, and matching dollars at the farmers market for residents on food assistance. Harvest donations to pantries rose steadily across the summer. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harbor Area Food Bank, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Move the matching program indoors with a winter market and plan fall planting of cold-hardy greens at both new gardens.
